definitions.explanation: A Japanese single-edged blade shorter than about 30 cm, carried by samurai as a secondary weapon or for self-defence. Also used of daggers in general.

examples.japanese: {短刀|たんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧。
⟦{博物館|はくぶつかん}→博物館：01494_hakubutsukan⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{古|ふる}い→古い：00488_furui⟧{短刀|たんとう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{展示|てんじ}→展示：12401_tenji⟧⟦されている→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: An old short sword is on display in the museum.

examples.japanese: ⟦{時代劇|じだいげき}→時代劇：12968_jidaigeki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦{武士|ぶし}→武士：03989_bushi⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{懐|ふところ}→懐：12631_futokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{短刀|たんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{隠|かく}し{持|も}って⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧⟦{場面|ばめん}→場面：03702_bamen⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦よく→よく：00601_yoku⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: In period dramas there are often scenes of a samurai with a dagger hidden in the fold of his kimono.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{短|たん}→短〜：03959_tan⟧ (short) and {刀|とう} (sword). A historical and literary word; in everyday speech a knife is ⟦ナイフ→ナイフ：01039_naifu⟧ or ⟦{包丁|ほうちょう}→包丁：04976_houchou⟧.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {短刀|たんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{抜|ぬ}く→抜く：02384_nuku⟧: to draw a dagger
- {短刀|たんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{突|つ}きつける→突きつける：10542_tsukitsukeru⟧: to hold a dagger at someone
- ⟦{懐|ふところ}→懐：12631_futokoro⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{短刀|たんとう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{忍|しの}ばせる→忍ばせる：12680_shinobaseru⟧: to hide a dagger in one's kimono

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{刀|かたな}→刀：02194_katana⟧: sword — the long sword
- ⟦{日本刀|にほんとう}→日本刀：31412_nihontou⟧: Japanese sword (the general term)
- ⟦ナイフ→ナイフ：01039_naifu⟧: knife — a modern knife
